scope: Host execution of the original portable Engine/Heap code, controlled actual-owner identities and deterministic non-LIFO suspension boundaries. This is separate from the actual pre-fix emulator failure and does not yet prove a corrected NRO.

environment.scope: Only this command process; previous value restored afterward

command.note: Reported near-zero test runtime is not a scheduling or performance benchmark.

contracts: Production Engine.gc and actual Heap allocation pinning retain local-only B and B host temporary when older A publishes, forces GC and unwinds first; objects reclaim after their own roots/scopes exit.
Independent frame publication, labels and non-LIFO return remove only the matching owner/ticket.
Same-owner nested JNI-shaped reentry retains outer roots and removes only the inner frame.
1024 active-owner cap returns VM_FRAME_BUDGET; 4096 sequential finished identities do not accumulate frame owner records.
Heap scope restoration preserves another owner allocation pins and cutoff; idle scope owner records prune.
A guest allocation never inherits a newer unrelated owner host scope pin.

implementation.collection: Trace frames and host pins for every owner, including native-suspended owners
implementation.diagnostics: Labels/depth belong to executing owner; error PC is local to the Rust invocation across foreign calls, avoiding an identity lookup per instruction
implementation.lifetime: VM lease still serializes access and releases across native calls; no global ban or hold across JNI callbacks introduced
implementation.unwind: Stable frame owner+serial ticket and heap owner+depth cookie
implementation.frame_identity: NativeHost.current_thread_id supplied by real Horizon Session; default single interpreter remains owner0 when no thread identity provider is present
implementation.std_path: Original std single-interpreter Vec stacks/diagnostic PC retained
implementation.test_only_api: Explicit portable-test-support hidden contract reexport, enabled only by as-switch-smoke portable-tests, absent from default device features
implementation.owner_metadata: At most1024 active frame owners, idle frame/scope records removed on final unwind; existing per-owner VM max_depth enforced

limitations: Controlled host identity switches model a native VM-lease suspension boundary; these six tests do not run OS workers or ARM64 machine code.
The unchanged original APK d8194d04fdd0fc749ab6ab327d4397cbb32944e8665bb00fed54e93719decb59 reproduced the failure on the older actual NRO. A corrected actual NRO run remains separately required.
